name: Confusion Bomb
body:
Confusion Bomb (Su)*
Source Ultimate Magic pg. 15
The alchemist’s bombs twist the target’s perception of friend and foe. A creature that takes a direct hit from a confusion bomb takes damage from the bomb. The creature is also under the effect of a confusion spell for 1 round per caster level of the alchemist unless they succeed at a Will save. Reduce the amount of normal damage dealt by the bomb by 2d6 (so a bomb that would normally deal 6d6+4 points of damage deals 4d6+4 points of damage instead). An alchemist must be at least 8th level before selecting this discovery.
